hints.content: A dilation by a scale factor of $2$ will map $C'$ to a point $2$ times as far from $P$ as point $C$ was, but in the same direction.

Point $C$ is $\purpleC{5}$ units right from point $P$.

The image $C'$ will be $2(\purpleC{5})=10$ units right and $2(\maroonD{0})=0$ units up from point $P$.
